newsitem.title: UK: Cable & Wireless shares rise on HK talks.
newsitem.headline: Cable & Wireless shares rise on HK talks.

text.p: Cable & Wireless shares rose in early trading on Friday after Hong Kong Telecommunications Ltd said C&W was in talks with the Chinese authorities on future cooperation between the two.
Cable & Wireless shares were up 21 pence at 519 pence at 0733 GMT.

There has been speculation that C&W would sell part of its approximately 59 percent interest in Hong Kong Telecom to a Chinese entity, prompting buying interest in the Hong Kong-based company's shares.
This has also led to suggestions that C&W would be given access to the potential of the huge Chinese market.
"It was always going to have to happen at some stage...if they get an open door into China they will be getting into potentially the biggest telecoms market in the world," a dealer told Reuters.
A C&W spokesman declined to add anything to the Hongkong Telecom statement.
